body.para: Creates a new, empty table with the same structure as the current table, using the FoxPro syntax. This is the FoxPro version of the COPY STRUCTURE command.

COPY STRUCTURE TO <TableName>
[FIELDS <FieldList> | FIELDS LIKE <Skeleton> | FIELDS EXCEPT <Skeleton>]
[WITH CDX | WITH PRODUCTION]
[DATABASE <DbName> [NAME <LongTableName>]]
TO <TableName>The name of the new table.
WITH CDX | WITH PRODUCTIONAlso copies the tags from the production index file (CDX) of the current table to a new CDX file for the new table.
DATABASE <DbName> [NAME <LongTableName>]Adds the new table to the specified database. The NAME clause specifies the long name of the table in that database.
The new table is created but not opened. The structure of the new table can only contain the fields that are selected with the FIELDS clause.

USE Customers
COPY STRUCTURE TO CustomersEmpty WITH CDX
COPY STRUCTURE TO Names FIELDS LastName, FirstName
COPY STRUCTURE, COPY STRUCTURE EXTENDED (FoxPro), COPY TO (FoxPro), DbCopyStructFox()
